description: When participant access is unavailable, release a synthetic dataset mirroring the intended logging schema and study design so that trace-based measures, modelling workflows, and analysis pipelines can be developed, compared, and stress-tested openly.

description: The study applies systematic literature mapping (SLM) following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, defined as providing \"a comprehensive overview of the available literature within a defined time frame, identifying trends, methodological approaches, and research gaps\".
title: Systematic literature mapping (SLM)

description: The article defines systematic reviews as a distinct genre of research synthesis.
title: Systematic review

description: The guide recommends that researchers and policymakers \"discuss issues to consider when identifying potential opportunistic experiments\" before undertaking one, treating candidate screening as a deliberate step rather than an afterthought.
title: Systematic screening for opportunistic experiments

description: The article adopts Halliday's Systemic Functional Grammar definition of Theme as \"point of departure of the message\", recognized because it \"is put in the first position\", followed by the Rheme.
title: Systemic Functional Linguistic Theme typology
